full_name: Kathleen Ossip | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Kathleen Ossip, who teaches at the New School, is interested in writing poems that are grounded in real life and open to the complexities and craziness of the contemporary world. Her books explore how vast poetry is, and how many different approaches it can contain.
